steps.body: Subtract by place when each top digit has enough: ones, then tens, then hundreds.
steps.narration: Subtract by place when each top digit has enough: ones, then tens, then hundreds.

widget.prompt: Build what remains: 568 take away 234 leaves this number.

commonBuilds.feedback: That kept all 8 ones — but 4 of them were taken away, leaving 4.

widget.missFeedback: That build names a different number — total each unit's worth and match 334 exactly.
widget.successFeedback: 3 flats, 3 rods, 4 cubes — each place gave up its own share.

predict.prompt: 568 − 234: does any column need a trade?

options.label: No — every top digit is bigger

predict.reveal: 8 is at least 4, 6 is at least 3, and 5 is at least 2. Each place has enough, so no trade is needed.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g2b sub no trade.
invariants: Trading between places changes the form of a quantity, never its value — the model and the number must stay equal for g2b sub no trade.
misconceptions: Treating a trade as adding or removing amount instead of renaming the same total.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the blocks stop matching the written number?

explanationVariants: Each place has enough to subtract.

commonErrors.feedback: That joined the two amounts; taking away calls for subtraction.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Line the places up — hundreds with hundreds, tens with tens, ones with ones — and work one column at a time.
